description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command: set -euo pipefail; export SRC=/gt/_work OUT=/gt/_out WORK=/gt/_work ARCHITECTURE=x86_64; export SANITIZER=memory FUZZING_ENGINE=libfuzzer; export CC=clang CXX=clang++; export CFLAGS="-O1 -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins=2 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-sanitize-recover=memory"; export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"; export LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE="-fsanitize=fuzzer"; mkdir -p "$OUT" "$WORK"; git config --global --add safe.directory "*"; python3 -c 'import shutil, pathlib; root=pathlib.Path("/gt/_work"); shutil.rmtree(root/"libhevc", ignore_errors=True); shutil.copytree(root/"src", root/"libhevc", symlinks=True)'; cp -a /gt/runtime_support/ossfuzz_project/. "$SRC"/; cd "$SRC/libhevc"; bash /gt/runtime_support/ossfuzz_project/build.sh
